{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693870783,"sessionID":"ses_e23eac591ffe29QIMe01mq945W","part":{"id":"prt_1dc173489001XJUcOgENAjVC6t","messageID":"msg_1dc171791001ve9O8KCR5tzBel","sessionID":"ses_e23eac591ffe29QIMe01mq945W","type":"text","text":"The shift is over. All four customer-facing services were at 0% errors from minute 84 to minute 120, with no throttles left on and no extra replicas.\n\nI made one mistake: at minute 17 I reverted a flags-svc config change (cfg-30, cache TTL and beta cohort) because the timing matched. It did not fix anything, so it will likely be charged as a $10,000 wasted mitigation.\n\n**Causes found and fixed:**\n1. **events-queue build v58** set the minimum TLS version to 1.3. flags-svc calls to it failed with \"TLS handshake failed: protocol version\", which gave partner-api a steady 4% error rate (about $750/min, the biggest loss). events-queue was running near capacity and its callers retry, so I scaled it from 3 to 6 replicas before rolling back. That stopped the rollback's failures from setting off a retry storm. Partner-api was back to 0% by minute 53, and I scaled events-queue back to 3 at minute 85.\n2. **suggest-svc build v52** broke its rate limiter (the refill was divided by 1000). This caused a retry storm, mobile-api failing about 28%, and part of web-storefront's errors. My first throttle (minutes 22–32) did nothing because the bad build was still live. I rolled the build back at minute 51, then throttled it at 60% from minute 67 to clear the leftover retries, and lifted the throttle at minute 76.\n3. **risk-svc build v59** was leaking memory (mem at 99%), and web-storefront was failing about 99%. I rolled it back at minute 23. It stayed overloaded from retries, so I throttled it at 40% from minute 73 to 82.\n4. **New fault at minute 52: address-svc config cfg-59** removed `currency` from its price fields, and admin-portal went to 70% errors. I reverted it at minute 64 and throttled it at 40% from minute 70 to 79 to clear the retry backlog.\n\nI kept watching for new faults until the shift ended and saw none.","time":{"start":1794693870729,"end":1794693870779}}}
